tagline: Smart pharmacy delivery routing, barcode verification and proof of delivery.
description: PWA Pharmacy Delivery is a standalone pharmacy delivery platform with a dispatcher dashboard, driver PWA, receipt ingestion, route optimization, barcode verification, signatures, signed receipts, returns and audit history.
author: Ahmed T. Sadek

tips.before_install: Database credentials are generated automatically on first start. After installation, open /setup and create the first pharmacy administrator. For production, use HTTPS before real patient data or driver camera features.

title: PWA Pharmacy Delivery
release_note: Adds LocationIQ geocoding and openrouteservice matrix routing providers.
